annotations.title: Find a Phorme gym or class

description: Use this when the user wants a gym, studio or class to train at in person, for example "a strength class in Austin this week" or "a gym near me". It returns up to five Phorme gyms, studios and other places to train in the city named or, when no city is named, within 60 km (or radius_km) of the approximate location the assistant shares, nearest or best matching first, each with its page on phor.me and its classes in the coming days with the class id, local start time, length, places left and a link to book on phor.me. When nothing matches it returns alternatives: the nearest places further out, and a home plan from a Phorme coaching brain. It reads only and shows no prices; booking a class for a signed-in user is a separate step.

city.description: The city the user named, for example "Austin".

class_type.description: The kind of class, only if the user said, for example "barbell" or "yoga".

days.description: How many days ahead to look. Default 7.

radius_km.description: How far to look, in km. Default 60. Use a larger one only when the user said they would travel.

name: find_gym_class

alternatives.description: When nothing matched or no class is scheduled: kind (wider_radius, other_cities, home_plan), line (what to offer), tool, and for wider_radius the nearest places further out. Offer them; never leave the user with nothing.

limits.description: What this does not cover. Tell the user.

places.description: Gyms, studios and other places to train, nearest or best matching first: place_id, name, kind, line, city, country, distance_km, page_url and classes (class_id, the id book_gym_class takes, then title, line, starts, minutes, spots_left, book_url).

title: Find a Phorme gym or class
